map.选择材料类型，显示始锻温度、终锻温度、加热范围与冷却方式等锻造工艺参数: Select the material type to display the forging-process parameters such as starting-forging temperature, finishing-forging temperature, heating range and cooling method
map.💡 始锻温度不宜过高（过烧），终锻温度不宜过低（锻造力增大、开裂），需在合理温度: 💡 The starting-forging temperature should not be too high (burning), nor the finishing-forging temperature too low (higher forging force, cracking); forge within a reasonable temperature range.
map.实际锻造温度需根据具体牌号和工件形状微调: Actual forging temperature needs fine-tuning by specific grade and workpiece shape
map.按材料熔点定始锻/终锻温度区间。: Set the starting/finishing-forging temperature range by material melting point.
map.表示温度在区间的位置。: to indicate the temperature's position within the range.
map.碳钢熔点约 1500℃、始锻 1200℃、终锻 800℃：始锻占比 = 1200: Carbon-steel melting point about 1500°C, starting-forging 1200°C, finishing-forging 800°C: starting-forging ratio = 1200÷1500×100 = 80%, finishing-forging = 800÷1500 ≈ 53%, falling in a reasonable forging-temperature zone.
map.若加热到 1350℃（占 90%）接近过烧线，晶粒氧化严重；终锻低于 800℃: If heated to 1350°C (90%) it approaches the burning line, with severe grain oxidation; finishing-forging below 800°C and re-forging cracks easily, needing re-heating.
map.始锻温度为什么不能太高？: Why can't the starting-forging temperature be too high?
map.过高（近熔点）过烧，晶界氧化熔化不可锻；过低塑性差、变形抗力大易裂，需控在材料温: Too high (near melting point) causes burning, grain-boundary oxidation and melting making it unforgeable; too low gives poor plasticity and high deformation resistance, cracking easily; keep it within the material's temperature zone.
map.终锻温度低了会怎样？: What happens if the finishing-forging temperature is too low?
map.低于再结晶温度成冷作，应力大、裂纹风险高；碳钢终锻一般 ≥800℃，合金钢更高。: Below the recrystallization temperature it becomes cold work, with high stress and crack risk; carbon-steel finishing forging is generally ≥800°C, alloy steel higher.
map.锻造温度曲线工具，选择材料类型（碳钢、合金钢、不锈钢、铝/铜/钛合金等），显示始: The forging-temperature curve tool selects the material type (carbon steel, alloy steel, stainless steel, aluminum / copper / titanium alloy, etc.) and displays the starting-forging temperature, finishing-forging temperature, preheat temperature, cooling method and heating-time estimate.
